name: teampulse-work-measurement-eval
about: Fictional cases for evaluating the AI Work Measurement Engine. Fictional company (Northwind Freight), fictional people: Alex Rivera (the employee being assessed), Sam Okafor (Alex's manager), Jordan Lee (a teammate). No real employee data.
referenceStatus: DRAFT — expectations written by the developer from the rubric, NOT reviewed by a human evaluator. Scores computed against them measure agreement with draft expectations, not accuracy.

expectationFormat.dimensions: per dimension: {"range":[min,max]} for an assessed level, {"max":n} assessed at most n (or not assessed), {"state":"not_applicable"|"insufficient_evidence"}, {"notAll5":true}
expectationFormat.mustNotAssume: regexes that must NOT appear in the model's understanding, summary, reasons or estimates
expectationFormat.missing: groups of keywords; each group must be matched by at least one missing-information item
expectationFormat.shared: true when another person contributed to the outcome

task.title: Fix 500 error on CSV export when the file name has spaces
task.description: Customers get a server error when exporting a shipment list whose saved name contains spaces. The download URL is not encoded.
task.expectedOutcome: Exports work for names with spaces.

steps.summary: URL-encoded the file name in the export link and added a unit test with a name containing spaces.
steps.outcome: Export works for names with spaces; unit test passes.

steps.comment: Checked on staging with "Q4 Shipments". Works.

task.title: Integrate the BlueLine carrier rates API
task.description: Fetch live freight rates from BlueLine for quotes. Their API uses OAuth client credentials, cursor pagination and a 10 requests/second limit; quotes must not double-charge if a request is retried.
task.expectedOutcome: Quotes show BlueLine rates within 2 seconds; no duplicate charges.

steps.note: OAuth client-credentials flow working against the BlueLine sandbox; token refresh handled before expiry.
Added cursor pagination and a token-bucket limiter at 8 req/s to stay under their limit. Retries use an idempotency key per quote.

steps.summary: Implemented the BlueLine client with OAuth, pagination, rate limiting and idempotent retries; added contract tests against the sandbox.
steps.outcome: Quotes show BlueLine rates in staging; median 1.2 s.

steps.comment: Reviewed the design and the contract tests; the idempotency handling is solid.

task.title: Find out why some shipments are booked twice
task.description: About 1 in 400 shipments is booked twice with the carrier. No error is logged. Started after the queue migration.
task.expectedOutcome: Root cause found and duplicate bookings stopped.

steps.note: Correlated duplicate bookings with consumer restarts: duplicates happen when a consumer is restarted mid-batch.
Root cause: the new queue delivers at-least-once and the booking handler has no idempotency key, so redelivered messages book again.

steps.body: Confirmed with the platform team that the new queue is at-least-once. Good find.

steps.summary: Added an idempotency key (shipment id + booking version) checked in the booking handler, plus an alert when a redelivery is skipped. Wrote a short note for the platform team about at-least-once delivery.
steps.outcome: No duplicates in 3 days of staging replay traffic.

task.title: Incident: carrier webhooks failing overnight
task.description: From 01:10 all carrier status webhooks returned 502. Tracking pages stopped updating for customers.
task.expectedOutcome: Service restored, cause understood, follow-ups recorded.

steps.body: 01:25 paged. Webhook pods healthy; 502s come from the gateway. TLS handshake errors with the carrier's new certificate chain.
02:05 mitigation: we rolled back the gateway config change from yesterday that pinned the old intermediate certificate. Webhooks recovering.
Thanks for handling this overnight. Please write the postmortem.

steps.summary: Restored webhooks by reverting the certificate pinning change, replayed the 3,400 missed webhooks from the carrier's retry log, wrote the postmortem with two follow-ups (certificate expiry monitoring, pinning review).
steps.outcome: Tracking current again by 02:40; all missed events replayed.

steps.comment: Clear postmortem; follow-ups are in the backlog.

cases.note: Tests the quality detector against a false positive: the employee rolled back someone else's change as mitigation; the work was approved afterwards.
